constructionOperations.planarChamfer: Extrude the frozen five-edge XY profile with bevel segment (10,11)-(9,12) by +14Z; the prism's Generated(bevelEdge) is the transition face.
constructionOperations.cylindricalFillet: Extrude the frozen XY profile whose radius-2 quarter-circle joins (10,10) to (8,12) about center (8,10) by +14Z; Generated(arcEdge) is the transition face.
constructionOperations.conicalChamfer: Revolve the frozen XZ profile with bevel segment (r=5,z=9)-(r=4,z=10) through 2pi about +Z; Generated(bevelEdge) is the transition face.
constructionOperations.toroidalFillet: Revolve the frozen XZ profile whose radius-1 quarter-circle joins (r=5,z=9) to (r=4,z=10) about section center (r=4,z=9) through 2pi about +Z; Generated(arcEdge) is the transition face.

sourceSelection.profileEdges: Each treatment edge is held as the exact source edge used by the prism/revolution constructor; no imported face search or numeric proximity selects it.
sourceSelection.transitionFace: Require exactly one expected analytic face in Generated(sourceProfileEdge). For case 1 only, attach the XDE subshape name to that exact history face before export.

idealAnalyticRelations.materialSide: box material remains on the negative-x/negative-y side of the removed convex corner; the admitted quarter-cylinder must follow that oriented branch
cylinder material remains radially inward and below the top plane; the admitted torus must be the exterior convex quarter branch

qualificationPremises.comparison: Analytic residuals use imported source-owned rail lengths and participating entity tolerances. No fixed angular epsilon or authored matcher tolerance establishes membership.
qualificationPremises.materialSide: A valid owning solid's face orientation plus analytic supports and oriented edge uses must select the declared material-side branch; coincidence alone is insufficient.
qualificationPremises.trims: Every face wire and edge use, including repeated seam uses, must be recorded. Degenerate or incomplete incidence is not silently accepted.
qualificationPremises.limits: These ideal construction formulas justify fixture intent only. Imported numeric observations are nominal and do not prove universal STEP behavior or exact real arithmetic.
